paragraphs.text: Make Progress a Rhythm, Not an Event.
Connect persistent, permissioned progression with deliberate daily action, weekly review, monthly patterns, and organizational learning.
What matters now? What does the next action require?
What moved? What stalled? What keeps recurring?
Where are priorities aligned? Where is capability constrained? Where is execution losing consistency?
